posts.text: Very excited to be joining NVIDIA as a Distributed Systems Intern! From starting tinytpu.com with Evan Lin, Surya Sure, and Kenny Guo, to joining Groq and now NVIDIA, it's been such an incredible journey. Special thanks to Omar Kilani and Gavin Sherry for their continual support and for making this transition possible. Super hyped to keep building with them!

I spent the last 3 months building TinyTPU, a minimal AI accelerator that runs both batched inference and training fully on-chip. Huge thanks to my teammates Evan Lin, Surya Sure, and Kenny Guo. Check out how we built it @ tinytpu.com All of our code can be found in our GitHub repo: https://lnkd.in/eEV6V2ND Twitter thread: https://lnkd.in/eEQZe-k4 I'd be happy to answer any questions, DMs are open!

I'm excited to share that my first-ever peer-reviewed paper as lead author has been published in The Designs Journal! We developed a novel tiling algorithm for designing and coating real-life novelty architecture buildings and objects with solar PV modules, and an augmented Python version of the System Advisor Model (SAM) to simulate the performance of the resultant irregularly shaped PV systems. Link: https://lnkd.in/e_GpneBU DOI: 10.3390/designs8060118 A special thank you to Professor Joshua P
So glad to have done this with you guys!
